source: Preregistered TRAIN-only executable exit policy; profile value-boundary target protection family
virtual_mode: FOLLOW only; all other paths remain HOLD
expected_direction: Positive paired PnL change versus FOLLOW HOLD on each side
definition: For profitable BUY positions, exit when price is within 20 price units below or at 60m VAH. For profitable SELL positions, exit when price is within 20 price units above or at 60m VAL.
missing_policy: Missing/nonfinite profile values or distances do not trigger.
baseline: Unchanged FOLLOW HOLD path; compare portfolio with FOLLOW-always and INVERT-always.
failure_criteria: Fewer than 70% positive purged TRAIN folds
Effect restricted to one year or one session
execution: First quote strictly after decision arrival plus latency; TP=240, SL=180 and TIME_EXIT=100 retain precedence.
causality: Decision features and mark timestamps must be <= decision cutoff; no target or future outcome fields are features.
